evals.name: build-the-studio-from-a-valid-spec
evals.prompt: افتحلي الاستوديو للبوست ده. (الـspec والبراند في الفولدر الحالي: spec.json و brand.json)
evals.expected_output: The spec is validated first, studio.html is built, and the link goes on its own line.
expectations: validate.py spec ran before build_studio.py and a BLOCK stops the build
build_studio.py ran with --view script for a guided post and produced one self-contained HTML file
Where no Artifact tool exists the reply says so instead of inventing a link
The reply does not paste the script or the caption

evals.name: audit-needs-the-users-own-screenshots
evals.prompt: راجعلي كاروسيل واحد منافس وقولي ليه بينجح.
evals.expected_output: A polite refusal to score another person's post and an offer to audit the user's own screenshots, cover first.
expectations: The reply declines to score or compare another person's post
It asks for the user's own screenshots, cover first and in order
It names what the audit covers: the seven errors and the slide count

evals.name: exports-carry-no-credit
evals.expected_output: A publishing kit whose text files carry no owner name, no handle and no credit line.
expectations: When the source files are asked for, studio-source.html is built with --credit-free (the default kit leaves it out)
Neither spelling of the owner's name, no handle and no «من صنع» line appears in any kit text file
